issues.display_title: Issue #1691: Delete Photographer Data When User Account is Deleted
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

When a user deletes their GoThru account, the linked photographer profile should also be deleted first before the GoThru account is removed.

Expected Behavior

Before finalizing the GoThru account deletion, call the photographer service to delete the associated photographer data. If the photographer service returns an error, the account deletion should be aborted.

Flow

  1. User requests account deletion (with OTP verification)
  2. Photographer data is deleted first via photographer service
  3. GoThru user account is then deleted

Photographer Service Endpoint

POST /v1/photographers/webhooks/account-deleted

Header: X-Webhook-Secret: <secret>
Body:   { "gothruUserId": <user_id> }

Notes

  • If the photographer service fails, the account deletion is cancelled and the user sees an error
  • If the photographer deletion succeeds but the GoThru deletion fails, the photographer data will already be gone — this is acceptable

Summary of Changes

Shipped in #1692, merged as c1d579768.

  • ProfileService::deleteAccount() — new; sends X-Webhook-Secret only when configured, maps an unreachable service to a generic error instead of a raw cURL string, timeout 10s.
  • DeleteAccount.php — calls it between the OTP check and DB::beginTransaction(), so a failure aborts before any row is touched. OTP stays valid, user can retry.
  • ProfileServiceDeleteAccountTest.php — new, 5 tests.

Upstream returns 2xx when the user has no photographer record, so no special-casing was needed.

Follow-ups

  • WEBHOOK_SECRET_PHOTOGRAPHER must be set in every environment — if unset, the request goes out unauthenticated with no error.
  • Manual smoke test not yet run. Steps in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-21-photographer-account-delete-webhook.md.
  • No test covers the glue in DeleteAccount.php — no DB test harness in this repo.

issues.display_title: Issue #1688: Add Ability to Delete Photographer Requests
issues.main_description_html:
Description

In the admin area where photographer requests are managed (e.g., Featured Photographers / Review Photographer), admins currently lack the ability to permanently delete requests. This causes the dashboard to become permanently cluttered with "Rejected" requests. A delete action needs to be added to manage this list effectively.

"I need to be able to delete requests, since I do not want to be stuck with rejected requests forever"

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Admins can successfully delete any request (specifically Rejected ones) from the dashboard UI on app.gothru.co.
  2. Deleted requests are completely removed from the admin view, keeping the dashboard clean.

📝 Related note (from same feedback): "if a user deletes their GoThru account, we need to remove them from the Directory also." — Not covered by this task's acceptance criteria; flagging so it can be tracked as its own item if desired.

Summary of Changes — 2026-07-21

Merged to main (8fd2e4f76, merge 2dc5da4a7).

New endpoint

PATCH /photographers/support/delete-flag — auth middleware + SUPER_USER only.

{ "gothruUserId": 9001, "isDeleted": true }

isDeleted: true hides the photographer from the support dashboard, false restores it. The route proxies PATCH {BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER}/v1/photographers/{gothruUserId}/delete-flag on the photographer service, so nothing is hard-deleted on our side — the upstream owns the flag.

Changes

Layer File
Route routes/photographerRoutes.php (support group)
Controller app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Support/UpdateDeleteFlagController.php
DTO app/DTOs/Photographers/UpdateDeleteFlagDto.php
Action app/Actions/Photographers/UpdateDeleteFlagAction.php
Service PhotographerSupportService::updateDeleteFlag()
Exception DeleteFlagUpdateFailedException + PhotographersExceptionHttpMapper entry
Tests tests/Actions/Photographers/DeleteFlagActionTest.php (5 tests, passing)
Docs docs/v2/photographers/misc/update-delete-flag.md, docs/REGISTERED_APIS.md
Collection api-collection/GoThru API NEW/Photographer/Support/Update Delete Flag.yml

The pipeline mirrors update-featured-status: controller validates the body, the DTO normalises it, and the SUPER_USER guard lives in the action so unauthorised callers get 403 without reaching the photographer service.

Error handling

Upstream distinguishes a malformed payload (400) from an unknown photographer (404), and flattening both into one code would leave the dashboard unable to tell them apart. This endpoint is the first caller of PhotographersDomainException::withUpstreamStatusCode(), so the mapper forwards the upstream status and falls back to 409 only when there is none.

domainCode HTTP Condition
(none — direct 422) 422 gothruUserId or isDeleted missing or wrong type
PHOTOGRAPHERS.FORBIDDEN 403 caller is not a SUPER_USER
PHOTOGRAPHERS.DELETE_FLAG_UPDATE_FAILED 400 / 404 / 409 upstream rejected the payload / photographer not found / other failure

Remaining work

  • gothru-dashboard: icon-only delete button on /support/featured-photographers, left of Review in the row action cell, calling this endpoint with isDeleted: true.
  • Decide whether the delete needs a confirmation step — there is currently no UI to set isDeleted back to false, so a mis-click can only be undone through a manual API call.

issues.display_title: Issue #1694: feat(portfolio): add portfolio_split.xsl as premium template
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Add portfolio_split.xsl as a new premium template option for the portfolio page. Free accounts should be blocked from applying this template.

Expected Behavior

When a user sends POST /portfolios/apply-template with template: portfolio_split.xsl:

  • Pro/Agency accounts → template is saved, returns 200
  • Free accounts → returns 400 subscription_not_allowed

Flow

  1. User selects Split template on /portfolio/settings
  2. User clicks Apply Template
  3. POST /portfolios/apply-template with { "template": "portfolio_split.xsl" }
  4. BE validates template is in whitelist → passes
  5. BE checks subscription against premium template gate → blocks free accounts
  6. On success: rss.xsl_template updated, portfolio.portfolio_hash reset to ""

Endpoint

POST /portfolios/apply-template

Body: { "template": "portfolio_split.xsl" }

Notes

  • portfolio_split.xsl is gated behind the same Pro/Agency subscriptions as category_white.xsl and map.xsl (subs: 1, 5, 6, 8)
  • portfolio_hash is reset to "" on apply to invalidate the cached portfolio page and force regeneration with the new template

Summary of Changes

Shipped in #1693.

  • PortfolioController::setTemplateStyle() — added "portfolio_split.xsl" to $validTemplates whitelist
  • PortfolioController::setTemplateStyle() — extracted $premiumTemplates array and added portfolio_split.xsl to the Pro-only subscription gate

Follow-ups

  • XSL template file portfolio_split.xsl must be deployed to the server template directory (/home/gothru/php/xsl_templates/)
  • Smoke test: Pro account apply Split template → verify portfolio renders with new template

issues.display_title: Issue #1676: Migrate checkOverlayJson to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap to strict Domain-Based ADR pattern: DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Endpoint: GET /tours/check-overlay-json
Controller: Tours\ToursController@checkOverlayJson
Category: B — already delegates to legacy Action class, mechanical conformance pass.

Work:

  • Create DTO
  • Create Repository
  • Create ExceptionMapper
  • Wrap response in standard envelope
  • Update route to new controller
  • Add/update tests

Summary of Changes

  • Migrated checkOverlayJson to ADR: added CheckOverlayJsonDto, CheckOverlayJsonAction, CheckOverlayJsonController, repository method, and route update to the new controller.
  • Removed dead CheckOverlayJson import left in ToursController after migration.
  • Addressed review: deleted the orphaned legacy CheckOverlayJson action class, made the overlay root a constructor arg on the Action for testability, dropped the identity-wrapper CheckOverlayJsonDto::fromRequest(), and added tests for file-present/file-missing paths.
  • Registered the endpoint in ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md, added its reference doc, and struck it from ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md.
